title: School Boundaries & Identity Collision Defense (v0.4.18)
message: Enforced strict school boundaries on QR join codes, added collision-proof student generation with batch deduplication, and added handle disambiguation across all teacher views.
changelog:
• School Boundary Protection: Scans outside a student's DepEd school boundary are strictly blocked with custom Bento dialog notices.
• Same-Name Student Collision Defense: Generated student usernames now use 5-digit entropy and batch deduplication sets, eliminating account overwrites.
• Account Claiming & Recovery: Handled Auth collision recovery and teacher temporary password resets without account lockout.
• Teacher UI Disambiguation: Display @username handles across Class Roster, Material Assignment, and Analytics to distinguish students with identical names.
